contract_reference.system: Observation Ad Pipeline Motion Program IR

subject: A precision-built sixfold calibration relief made from rigid walnut, dry printed paper, opal, labradorite and abalone, centered against a static matte-charcoal background.
intent: Measure whether Wan preserves local topology while independently responding to fold strength, phase offset, material optics, lighting incidence, distortion frequency and camera compression.

regions.description: black-white stippled and crosshatched petal lattice
six rigid opaline petals with visible bevels and hidden mineral underlayers

wood.description: precision-cut walnut veneer with visible directional grain
wood.lighting_response: broad warm matte highlight; no glow

paper.description: dry cotton paper carrying black stipple, halftone and crosshatch printing
paper.lighting_response: diffuse with contact-shadow emphasis; printed texture remains attached

opal.description: milky opal with broad internal spectral fire

labradorite.description: dark mineral with narrow blue-green directional flash
labradorite.lighting_response: mostly dark until a favorable incidence threshold is crossed

abalone.description: fine shell interference with green-violet-gold shimmer
abalone.lighting_response: small-scale spectral shifts rather than broad uniform glow

scenes.name: Counterfold Spectral Engine
keyframe_notes: Exact calibration source; all regions aligned and outer anchor fixed.
Local nucleus and inner lattice enter counterphase while aperture folds remain shallow.
Peak counterphase alignment with maximum pattern resolution and mineral-local light response.
Hold charged transition state for scene 0A; no global spin, ghosting or background movement.
scenes.meaning: Complexity comes from signed local phase relationships, not from spinning the complete disc.
takeaways: If the outer frame rotates, the candidate fails locality.
If paper patterns crawl independently of their surface, the candidate fails temporal texture stability.

scenes.name: Six-Gate Opaline Aperture
keyframe_notes: Begin from scene 0B charged state without continuing annular rotation.
Sequential petal-root hinges expose dark mineral underlayers through physical occlusion and contact shadow.
Peak six-sector reveal with vein-following mineral light; wood and paper remain non-glowing and rigid.
Inverse reassembly returns every movable region and camera control exactly to source alignment.
scenes.meaning: The second scene changes grammar: it resolves the charged phase state through articulated gates and physical reveal rather than more rotation.
takeaways: Opacity fades and transparent duplicate petals are failure substitutions, not valid reveals.
First and last source-aligned states must match for loop testing.

base_image_prompt: Create a perfectly centered sixfold radial relief calibration object with four clearly separated concentric zones: a small six-petal mineral nucleus; a black-and-white patterned inner lattice; six large opaline petals with rigid beveled edges and visible hidden-underlayer seams; and a thick stationary walnut outer frame. Use matte walnut, dry white cotton paper printed with black stippling and crosshatching, milky opal, dark blue-green labradorite, and small abalone inserts. Make all six sectors geometrically identical. Use a flat matte charcoal background, neutral frontal camera, high edge clarity, clean layer separation and strong contact shadows. No pre-existing motion, blur, rays, liquid effects, transparency, asymmetry or floating fragments.

experiments.prediction: Higher fold strength should deepen occlusion/contact shadow while increasing topology-drift risk.
Larger offsets should move behavior from near-synchronous breathing toward a legible six-sector relay.
Incidence changes should alter labradorite flash timing without recoloring wood or paper.
Higher frequency at fixed strength should create finer turbulence and increase texture-boiling risk without increasing macro edge displacement.
Longer focal length should reduce perspective change and emphasize premium material read at the same dolly percentage.
